WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_record_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.race_name, s1.avg_points, s1.record_count,
         s1.record_count - s2.avg_record_count AS excess_count
  FROM step1 AS s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2
  WHERE s1.record_count > s2.avg_record_count
)
SELECT AVG(avg_points), AVG(record_count), AVG(excess_count)
FROM step3
